insights.title: High Frequency of Refresh Calls
insights.description: The endpoint POST /sfdemosite130/nml510_refresh_control.xml was called 23 times in a single test, indicating potential inefficiencies.
insights.recommendation: Investigate the necessity of multiple refresh calls to optimize performance.

insights.title: Login Actions Correlate with API Calls
insights.description: The UI actions for logging in directly correlate with multiple POST and GET requests to authentication endpoints.
insights.recommendation: Document the API calls triggered by UI actions for better understanding of user flows.

executiveSummary: • All tests executed successfully with no failed endpoints recorded.
• The highest number of calls was observed for the refresh control endpoint, indicating potential inefficiencies.
• User authentication processes involve multiple API calls, which may affect performance.
• The file upload and report generation workflows were successfully validated.
• Investigating the necessity of high-frequency refresh calls could enhance system performance.
• Understanding the relationship between UI actions and API calls can improve user experience.
